summary: TracingInterceptor and OpenTelemetryInterceptor in the Python SDK do not implement the new client.Interceptor methods for standalone activities, resulting in missing client-side OpenTelemetry spans when executing standalone activities.
userImpact: Users cannot trace standalone activity client calls with OpenTelemetry, making debugging and monitoring of distributed traces incomplete.
rootCause: TracingInterceptor and OpenTelemetryInterceptor classes do not implement the new client.Interceptor methods required for standalone activities.
proposedFix: Implement the new client.Interceptor methods in both TracingInterceptor and OpenTelemetryInterceptor to create spans for standalone activity client calls.
resolutionDetails: Implemented the missing client.Interceptor methods in the OpenTelemetry interceptor classes to support standalone activity tracing.
keyQuote: TracingInterceptor and OpenTelemetryInterceptor do not currently implement the new client.Interceptor methods related to standalone activities.
